intent: PSI-008: init Supabase locally (config, seed, db scripts), make supabase start and db reset work, and dissolve the stray top-level backend-architecture/ folder as the operator chose (option A).
summary: Ran supabase init at the repo root and set project_id p3md. On this Windows machine the default ports (54321-54329) and my first pick (54416-54515) are inside Hyper-V reserved ranges (netsh int ipv4 show excludedportrange), so Docker refused to bind 54422; config.toml now uses 54370-54379 (API 54371, DB 54372, Studio 54373, Inbucket 54374). seed.sql creates four fake users (member1, admin, member2, member3 at @p3md.test, password password123, fixed ids 0001-0004, with identities so email login works) and the three Vault secrets from the docs (project_url, site_url, internal_fn_secret). supabase start works; db reset applies the seed. db:types and db:reset scripts were added to the root package.json (supabase/ is at the repo root, so db:types writes to frontend-architecture/src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts) and db:types generated that file. Two pieces are not as the accept line says: (1) roles and groups are NOT seeded, because those tables come from migration M1 (PSI-012), which depends on PSI-008; seed.sql marks where PSI-012 must add them. (2) db reset failed with exit 1 on the first two runs after supabase start (seed fine, then the CLI's /storage/v1/bucket check timed out because Kong kept a stale IP for the restarted Storage container); after docker restart supabase_kong_p3md it exited 0 on three consecutive runs. That flake is documented in docs/backend-architecture/local-workflow-and-deploy.md. Also per the operator's choice (option A) the top-level backend-architecture/ folder was dissolved: the supabase-server skill was moved unchanged to the repo root for the four harnesses (.agents, .claude, .hermes, .zcode) with skills-lock.json; its package.json and package-lock.json (only @supabase/server, unused) were removed; its .env with real-looking hosted Supabase keys was renamed, without being read, to .env.hosted.local at the root, which git ignores. Nothing committed at the time of this entry; nothing pushed.

decisions.decision: Move all Supabase local ports to 54370-54379
decisions.reason: Windows reserved 54266-54365 and 54416-54515 on this machine, which covers the Supabase defaults; 54366-54415 was the free gap. Other Supabase stacks here (thinkboard) use 55321/55322 and are not affected
alternatives: Keep defaults and exclude the ranges with netsh (needs admin and a reboot)

decisions.decision: Seed users and Vault secrets now; leave roles and groups to PSI-012
decisions.reason: The roles and groups tables come from migration M1 (PSI-012), which depends on PSI-008; inserting into them now would make db reset fail
alternatives: Guarded DO blocks that seed only if the tables exist

decisions.decision: Use the globally installed Supabase CLI 2.75.0; do not add supabase as a devDependency
decisions.reason: The npm package downloads its binary in a postinstall script, which bun does not run by default; the docs also call plain supabase. 2.117.0 is available but upgrading changes container images and was not needed

It matched nothing in the docs' layout and held a real .env; the skills and lockfile go to the repo root, the unused @supabase/server dependency is dropped, the .env is kept out of git; NOTE option A said to keep one skill copy, but all four were kept because they were tracked separately and choosing which harness to drop is a human call (C-15)
alternatives: Keep it as the backend package and change the docs

decisions.decision: Keep the hosted keys file as .env.hosted.local at the root and never read it
decisions.reason: It is git-ignored by the **/.env.* rule and is not used by local dev; rotation is a human action in the Supabase dashboard
